title: When Hate Meets Facts: LLMs-in-the-Loop for Check-worthiness Detection in Hate Speech
abstract: arXiv:2603.25269v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hateful content online is often expressed using fact-like, not necessarily correct information, especially in coordinated online harassment campaigns and extremist propaganda. Failing to jointly address hate speech (HS) and misinformation can deepen prejudice, reinforce harmful stereotypes, and expose bystanders to psychological distress, while polluting public debate. Moreover, these messages require more effort from content moderators because they must assess both harmfulness and veracity, i.e., fact-check them. To address this challenge, we release WSF-ARG+, the first dataset which combines hate speech with check-worthiness information. We also introduce a novel LLM-in-the-loop framework to facilitate the annotation of check-worthy claims. We run our framework, testing it with 12 open-weight LLMs of different sizes and architectures. We validate it through extensive human evaluation, and show that our LLM-in-the-loop framework red

translated_title: 当仇恨遇上事实：基于大语言模型人机协同的仇恨言论可核查性检测
translated_abstract: 网络上的仇恨内容常常以看似事实但未必正确的信息形式表达，尤其是在有组织的网络骚扰活动和极端主义宣传中。未能同时处理仇恨言论（HS）和虚假信息可能会加深偏见、强化有害的刻板印象，并使旁观者遭受心理困扰，同时污染公共讨论。此外，这类信息需要内容审核人员付出更多精力，因为他们必须同时评估其危害性和真实性，即对其进行事实核查。为应对这一挑战，我们发布了WSF-ARG+，这是首个将仇恨言论与可核查性信息相结合的数据集。我们还引入了一种新颖的LLM-in-the-loop（大语言模型人机协同）框架，以促进对值得核查声明的标注。我们运行了该框架，并使用12个不同规模和架构的开源权重大语言模型进行测试。我们通过大量人工评估对该框架进行了验证，结果表明我们的LLM-in-the-loop框架……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发布了首个结合仇恨言论与可核查性信息的数据集WSF-ARG+，并提出一种大语言模型人机协同标注框架，利用12个开源LLM辅助检测仇恨言论中值得事实核查的声明，且经过人工评估验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: The paper releases WSF-ARG+, the first dataset combining hate speech with check-worthiness information, and introduces a novel LLM-in-the-loop annotation framework—tested with 12 open-weight LLMs and validated via human evaluation—to detect check-worthy claims in hate speech.
